facts.business: Unison Metals Limited is engaged in manufacturing of metal products including cold rolled patta-patti with batch making plant operations.

capacity_or_capex.item: Batch making plant modernization and automation with PLC integration
Automated combustion systems for melting processes
Machinery setup at Dhamatvan Property (capital advance to Goras Industries)

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to variety of products, markets, credit terms, delivery terms, discounts and volume concessions involving management judgement
Suspension of manufacturing operations of Cold Rolled Patta-Patti Plant
Non-moving inventory lying at Naaptol warehouse
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No transactions required shareholders' approval. Loans from Directors/relatives: Rs 11.42 lakhs at beginning of year, Rs 5.81 lakhs at year end. Details in Note 28 to standalone and consolidated financial statements. Policy available at www.unisongroup.net.
